note: Every TrackingConfig.toMap() key and whether each native configuration parser reads it. The Dart suite checks the key set; the ledger validator checks the native parsers.

accuracy.reason: Dart resolves the preset; natives read the resolved desiredAccuracy and sampling keys.

stationaryDesiredAccuracy.reason: Android keeps the moving request priority while stationary until reachable stationary detection (LBO-05) adds a separate stationary request level.

maximumPlausibleSpeedMetersPerSecond.reason: Enforced by the Dart fix-quality policy.

activityRecognitionIntervalMs.reason: Core Motion delivers activity changes without a sampling interval.

mockLocationPolicy.reason: Enforced by the Dart fix-quality policy.

largeGapThresholdMs.reason: Legacy alias of acceptedGeometryGapThresholdMs kept for older readers.

maximumProviderFixAgeMs.reason: Enforced by the Dart fix-quality policy.

acceptedGeometryGapThresholdMs.reason: Dart continuity classifier and quality policy.

notificationTitle.reason: The Android foreground-service notification; iOS has none.

notificationText.reason: The Android foreground-service notification; iOS has none.

android.stationaryTimeoutMs: Legacy alias of stationaryConfirmationMs for early clients.
android.notificationChannelId: Optional host override of the notification channel.
android.notificationChannelName: Optional host override of the notification channel.
android.notificationChannelDescription: Optional host override of the notification channel.

ios.stationaryTimeoutMs: Legacy alias of stationaryConfirmationMs for early clients.
ios.activityType: Flattened early-client key; Dart does not send it, so iOS uses .fitness until intent-derived activity types (LBO-07).
ios.allowBackgroundLocationUpdates: Flattened early-client key; Dart does not send it.
ios.requireAlwaysAuthorization: Flattened early-client key; Dart does not send it.
ios.showBackgroundLocationIndicator: Flattened early-client key; Dart does not send it.
